title.narrative: UNFPA-Humanitarian and Life-saving Activities in Sudan

description.narrative: UNFPA-Humanitarian and Life-saving Activities in Sudan: The project will enhance effort to access and avail lifesaving SRH services to the most vulnerable population in Sudan, guided by the minimum initial service package for SRH in emergencies. The project’s primary focus is on reducing excess maternal and neonatal mortalities and morbidities, addressing the needs of survivors of sexual violence, and providing clinical management for rape cases, reducing the burden of sexually transmitted diseases, preventing HIV, and minimizing unintended pregnancies through family planning services. The project also aims to enhance coordination among all stakeholders on the ground and support the transition into comprehensive SRH services as soon as the situation allows. The project is further focused on improving accountability to affected populations, including people with disabilities, and on the prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse. The project exemplifies UNFPA’s commitment to uphold the principle of "Leave No One Behind" within humanitarian settings.
